'''Yayax Squad''' was an elite [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commando]] unit, and was part of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. They were one of the squads trained by [[Rav Bralor]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]]. Members of Yayax Squad, like those of [[Omega Squad]], wore matching [[Katarn-class commando armor/Legends|Katarn armor]], a gray-and-brown dazzle-pattern which gave them a degree of camouflage in an urban environment. This gave them an advantage during the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]]. The squad was comprised of four clone commandos named [[Cov (clone trooper)|Cov]], [[Dev (clone trooper)|Dev]], [[Jind]], and [[Yover]].

During the Battle of Coruscant they assisted [[Omega Squad]] and [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC Trooper]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Aven (clone trooper)|Aven]] in defending the [[HoloNet News and Entertainment]] Headquarters building from [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] attack. They succeeded in protecting the building from droid attacks. They then assisted the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] in maintaining domestic security on the capital. After [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]] was enacted and [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] established the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], Yayax Squad deserted and joined [[Kal Skirata]] on [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]. They were taken to Mandalore by [[Nyreen Vollen|Nyreen "Ny" Vollen]] and [[A'den Skirata]] when she brought the body of [[Etain Tur-Mukan]] to Kal. The squad, alongside former [[Clone Commander/Legends|clone commander]] [[Levet (clone)|Levet]], became carpenters and farmers.
